entities.summary: Kazuyoshi Morita , known by his stage name Tamori (タモリ), is a Japanese comedian and television presenter. Known for his trademark dark sunglasses, Tamori is one of the "big three" television comedians in Japan along with Takeshi Kitano and Sanma Akashiya.
